method: Independent C# compilation with the installed Unity Editor Roslyn compiler, UnityEditor/UnityEngine module assemblies and Unity netstandard 2.1 reference assembly. UNITY_EDITOR defined; C# language version 9.0.
limitations: Compilation verifies C# syntax and referenced Unity API availability, not runtime behaviour of the importer or generated assets.
Run Tools/Hero Motion/Setup Humanoid Package inside Unity to create the Avatar, material, controller, prefab, AvatarMask and UnityImportReport.json.
Actual Humanoid retargeting, appearance, movement and scene contacts still require visual checks in Unity.
Unity 2022.3 compatibility was considered during implementation but was not compiled or imported in that Editor version.
